description: Lists a project's most recent flagged messages, newest first, with the reason, confidence, player id, context id and any reviewer verdict (TP or FP). Filter by date, category or player. Up to 50 per call. Not available for organizations that keep player data in a separate region unless Paxmod has enabled it.

category.description: Only this flag reason, for example Harassment.

since.description: Only messages after this date or time (ISO 8601), for example 2026-11-01.

name: list_flagged_messages
title: List flagged messages
